execution_cost_sqrt_impact.note: Two complementary papers: 2606.07059 derives sqrt-law impact from first principles (diffusivity constraint — realized and counterfactual price both diffusive); most propagator models fail this test; linear impact only under strong info coupling. 2606.13419 provides per-action synchronicity test for self-impact detection at N~50 fills. Combined: sqrt law is the right model AND is now early-detectable. Directly relevant to L19 (NQ slippage model) and Strategy B mainnet sizing. Operational implication: apply synchronicity test to logs/fills.csv (testnet HMSTR fills) before mainnet; check sqrt-law impact ceiling for planned mainnet notional vs ADV. Skeptic: 2606.07059 is theoretical; 2606.13419 is on equity LOB microstructure which differs from HL perpetual matching engine. Two papers = EMERGING.

open_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Fiat turbulence (VIX-correlated) is the primary stress propagation channel (2605.30442) — precedes crypto repricing. During risk-off, institutional leveraged long demand collapses on crypto perps 12-24h before spot reprices, compressing funding rates. VIX>25 identifies onset of this sequence. Kill-switch: reduce Strategy B 50% or exit fully when VIX closes >25; re-enter when VIX <20 on close.

open_hypotheses.description: Replacing Strategy A's 28-bar rolling std with a HAR(1,5,22) heterogeneous autoregressive vol estimator improves vol targeting accuracy and reduces crash-regime over-sizing, because BTC/ETH/SOL realized vol exhibits long memory (Hurst H > 0.5) that a single-scale window cannot capture.
open_hypotheses.data_required: BTC/ETH/SOL daily returns (Binance klines, already in Strategy A pipeline). No new data fetch required.
open_hypotheses.conflict_with_archived: none — Strategy A's 28-bar window is canonical but no alternative vol estimator has been tested or archived. HAR-TSMOM not in archived research history.
origin_themes: T7 (2606.06190 + 2606.09478) — regime-conditioned vol forecasting outperforms single-scale GARCH
open_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: BTC/ETH/SOL realized vol has long memory (Hurst H ~0.6-0.8). HAR(1,5,22) decomposes vol into daily/weekly/monthly components, providing earlier detection of vol expansion via weekly and monthly components already trending upward. The 28-bar rolling window lags because it is dominated by recent low-vol observations. This lag contributed to over-sizing just before the 2026-05-11 propfirm breach.
open_hypotheses.interaction_with_h002: H004 resolves the base vol question before H002 pre-registration. If RMSE(vol_HAR) / RMSE(vol_28d) < 0.95: H002 pre-registration uses vol_HAR as base (position = tanh_signal × clamp(vol_5d / vol_HAR, 0.5, 2.0)). If ≥0.95: close H004, H002 proceeds with vol_28d unchanged.
open_hypotheses.success_criterion: RMSE improvement ≥5% on holdout 2024-2026 → incorporate. <5% → close.
